notes:
- Use-case: per-request personalization ranking + short chat snippets. High QPS at peak sales events.
- Primary ask: guaranteed minimum throughput (tokens/sec) per reserved GPU pool + clear concurrency cap per customer shard.
- Terrane: "We need predictable tail latency under 95th/99th percentiles and a hard lower bound on tokens/sec for billing guarantees."
- Key negotiation items: min tokens/sec (SLO floor), concurrency cap definition (per-tenant vs per-API-key), burst window (60s vs 5m) and how bursts draw on reserved capacity vs metered overage.
- Redwood proposal v1: 3k t/s per A100-equivalent sustained, 10k t/s burst per pool for up to 60s, concurrency soft-cap 250 requests but will queue to maintain latency SLO.
- Terrane pushback: wants 4k sustained and 10m token burst budget per month, plus rebate if average sustained < contracted for >3 days.
- SE notes (Ravi): need to quantify prefix/KV cache hit impact — caching increases effective t/s for repeat sessions. Proposed measurement: 72h stability run with production traffic replay.
- Finance: wants tiered pricing for commit levels and a hard ceiling for burst overage.
- Legal: requires penalty table and explicit definition of what counts as "missed throughput" (observed average over 1h vs 24h).
- Action items captured in Drive: throughput-test-plan.xlsx, proposal-v2.pdf.
- Stubbing: Fireflies ff-20260309-sla-call contains call verbatim on penalty language.
- Quote: estimated monthly TCV for 12mo commit ~ $55k - $100k depending on final sustained t/s and reserved GPU count.
requirements_summary: Need Dedicated pool with guaranteed sustained tokens/sec per GPU, defined concurrency caps, configurable burst allowances with clear billing model; encryption in transit and at rest; audit logs and SSO. Rapid failover to hosted variants acceptable for non-PII traffic.
technical_acceptance_criteria: 1) Sustained throughput test: >= contracted t/s for 72h replayed production traffic. 2) 95th/99th latency within SLO under up to 80% of burst load. 3) Failover policy triggers within 30s when GPU pool capacity exhausted. 4) KV cache hit-rate documented and reproducible.
commercial_terms_requested: 12mo reserved capacity, monthly billing, tiered rebate scheme if throughput < contracted for >72 consecutive hours, explicit burst overage pricing, termination clause for SLA breaches (credit-based)
poa_next_steps: 1) Redwood to provide updated proposal v2 (throughput table + penalty tiers) by 2026-03-18. 2) Run 72h production traffic replay (date TBD) — SE to lead. 3) Legal to align on definition for 'missed throughput' and finalize penalty matrix. 4) Finance to approve commit level; Terrane to provide PO if approved.
